newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Staples remains calm.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Staples remains calm.

text.p: Stocks remained calm in after-hours trading with Staples Inc holding at its closing price and Office Depot Inc attracting no transactions minutes before a court ruling on their merger, dealers said Monday.
"I don't see much going on," said one trader.
Staples was trading at its Nasdaq close of 23-1/4.
U.S. District Court Judge Thomas Hogan was expected to announce his decision on the $4 billion merger at 1630 EDT/2030 GMT.
Office Depot closed at 19-7/16 after normal trading hours.
Both companies later saw their stocks halted for trading in anticipation of the judge's ruling.
"Keep on eye on them when they're released for trading again," said another trader.
Hogan eventually granted government officials a preliminary injunction to halt the merger deal between the two office superstore chains.
Cyrix Corp's stock was also halted from trading as it predicted lower than expected revenues and a loss in earnings for the second quarter.
The New York Stock Exchange said Monday that session one had a volume of 137,300 shares against 175,400 on Friday. Session two had 7.6 million against 2.6 million, it said.
